nailsaffair.name: Nails Affair
description: In the Roman Catholic tradition, the first known murder was the murder of Abel by the hands of his brother, Cain.
Convince the judges that there might be a twist to the story. As they say — caught red handed!
Bring it with your nails as the weapons.

face.name: Face
description: “Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth.”
Ezekiel 28:17
Bring it as a fallen angel.

realness.name: Realness
description: Before the fall, there was Paradise. Step into the Garden of Eden and show us the innocence, simplicity and divine beauty of the first humans before their descent from paradise.
Come as your own interpretation of the first inhabitants of Eden.
Bring it with an apple in hand.

bgperformance.name: Beginners’ Performance
description: You’ve been through the valley of the shadow of death, gone to hell and made it back.
Bring it as in a burnt and charred look.
Can you vogue through the night when you’re already burnt out..?

bgrunway.name: Beginners’ Runway
description: You’ve been lazy in life and your punishment is to keep it pumping.
Bring it in loungewear.

body.name: Body
description: In Dante’s Inferno, Cocytus is the ninth and deepest circle of Hell. It is a frozen lake where the souls of traitors are condemned to remain trapped beneath the ice. There is no fire here, only an endless, merciless cold.
Bring us a body frozen in the depths of Cocytus.
Give us frostbite, cracked skin, bruising and the illusion of a body slowly being consumed by the cold.

lipsync.name: Lip Sync
description: Harpies work under the gods to punish the ones who’ve offended them or have committed unspeakable acts.
Bring it with a song to vocalize your anger. Show us that you can drag a bitch straight to hell with the power of your words.
Remember to register your song for your 10s by sending an email with your mix attached to contact@sweetlikehoneymtl.com by Friday, October 9, 2026.

bazaar.name: Bazaar
description: Cerebus is described as the monstrous watchdog of the underworld who diligently served his master, the ruler of hell. After millenia, he needs a break.
Bring it as his successor, the new guardian of the gates of hell.

bestdressed.name: Best Dressed
description:
“Opulence! you own everything.”
– Junior LaBeija
Greed is a deadly sin. More is more and there’s no such thing as enough. Dive into the extravagance.
Bring it with an excess of accessories.

commvcomm.name: Commentator vs Commentator
description: Exorcisms have been performed for thousands of years. The girls are POSSESSED, it is your task to make sure no demons is left standing in your vicinity.
Bring it with a chant to cast away the most sinister spirits.

performance.name: Performance
description: The holy water was splashed, the prayers were read, and your physical body is fighting to save your soul.
Bring it as a person in the midst of an exorcism. Tell us the story of the demon on its way out.

runway.name: Runway
description: Death walks among us. You are now tasked to collect the souls of the damned. Show us how you’d escort a sinner out of this world and into the afterlife.
Bring it as the Grim Reaper and pump to collect your next target.

sexsiren.name: Sex Siren
description: You made a vow… and still chose temptation.
Tag team with a member of another houseand give us the ultimate forbidden affair. Secret lovers, stolen glances, betrayal, jealousy and sinful chemistry!
Bring it with the kind of temptation that could send you straight to the Second Circle of Hell.
